headline: Care that’s matched to your body and your goals.
intro: Every session is personalized. Clara listens to your concerns first, then recommends the methods that are most effective for your body, comfort level, and lifestyle.
careBody: Whether you need relief from chronic tension, support for a specific condition, better mobility, or a reset from a busy week, Clara matches each session to your body, comfort level, and goals.

pricingBody: This pricing menu reflects the current service list and add-ons offered in the clinic. Clara will help you choose the best option for your body, goals, and comfort level when you book.
